name: Add expense and watch the live ledger update
description: Verifies every saved transaction is reflected automatically in the six-column ledger view and remains after reload.
steps: Add an expense named Groceries with amount 250 and category Food
Verify a Groceries row shows Date, Type, Description, Category, Amount and Note
Close the ledger and refresh the app
expected: The Groceries row appears in the ledger without manual row entry and remains visible after refresh in the same browser.

name: Export a complete Excel workbook and CSV backup
description: Verifies saved transactions download into an Excel workbook and CSV backup.
steps: Create an expense called Lunch for 180
Switch to Income and add Allowance for 1000
Verify a pocketwise-expense-ledger XLSX download starts
expected: An Excel workbook downloads with Dashboard and Transactions sheets, the six transaction columns and a ₹1,200 budget summary; CSV export remains available.

name: Reject incomplete transaction entries on mobile
description: Verifies browser validation prevents an incomplete transaction from being recorded.
steps: Leave Description empty and enter amount 250
expected: Required-field validation blocks the incomplete transaction and no blank record appears.

name: Use the ₹1,200 monthly budget and retain the setting
description: Verifies the requested budget is applied and remains saved.
expected: Pocketwise displays and retains the ₹1,200 monthly spending budget unless changed by the user.

name: Open monthly history and review the selected month
description: Verifies monthly history summarizes browser-local records and can be closed without deleting data.
steps: Create an expense called Bus fare for 40 in the current month
Create an income called Allowance for 500 in the current month
Verify expenses of ₹40, income of ₹500 and a ₹1,200 budget
Verify Transport is shown as an expense category
expected: Monthly history shows the selected month’s totals, category breakdown and remaining budget; closing leaves records intact.
